definition_quote.value: "Practice of optometry" means the examination or measurement by any subjective or objective means including automated or testing devices for the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of conditions of the human eye, lid, adnexa, and visual system as outlined below.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of optometry" means the examination or measurement by any subjective or objective means including automated or testing devices for the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of conditions of the human eye, lid, adnexa, and visual system as outlined below.

value: Use, adapting, and fitting of all types of lenses or devices
Dispensing of contact lenses
Determination of refractive error or visual, muscular, or anatomical anomalies
Provision or prescription of vision therapy, low-vision rehabilitation, or developmental or perceptual therapy
Minor procedures on the surface of the skin of the ocular adnexa, cornea and conjunctiva
Use of pharmaceutical agents for diagnosis and treatment of diseases, disorders, and conditions of the eye and adnexa
methods_authorized.quote: "Practice of optometry" includes all of the following: Use, adapting, and fitting of all types of lenses or devices except as provided in paragraph (a)(2) of this section. Dispensing of any type of contact lenses... Determination of refractive error or visual, muscular, or anatomical anomalies of the eye. Provision or prescription of vision therapy, low-vision rehabilitation, or developmental or perceptual therapy.

drug_authority.value: Optometrists may prescribe pharmaceutical agents including Schedule II controlled substances containing Hydrocodone (max 72-hour supply), Schedules III, IV, and V controlled substances (max 72-hour supply), and oral steroids (limited to a single 6-day methylprednisolone dose pack). May use epinephrine auto-injector for anaphylaxis. Excludes oral immuno-suppressives (except oral steroids as specified), oral antifungals, oral antimetabolites, substances delivered intravenously or by injection, and medications solely for systemic conditions outside optometric scope.
drug_authority.quote: Includes the use of pharmaceutical agents for the diagnosis and treatment of diseases, disorders, and conditions of the eye and adnexa based on the licensing requirement that satisfies the requirement for graduate level coursework that includes general and ocular pharmacology
